notes.title: DLC Loyalty Program Clarification
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We apologize for the confusion regarding the DLC Loyalty Program. The original posts did not clarify that discount would last for a limited time, from 9/5-11/2.

This was a serious omission on our part and we will be sure to provide such critical information in our updates moving forward.

We apologize again for the lack of clarity and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: DLC Character Voice Adjustments
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just another small update, the DLC character voice volume has been adjusted in an attempt to bring it in line with the base game.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We just pushed out a small system update to improve some stability for some people.

Thank you!

notes.title: New Character DLC
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The new Kansen are ready for battle! We're excited to announce that the new character DLCs are now available for Purchase!

Check out the Bundle Page for extra savings!



Additionally, we wanted to reiterate the details of the Loyalty Program:

The Azur Lane: Crosswave New DLC loyalty program is a thank-you for those who pre-purchased Azur Lane: Crosswave on Steam. Only users who purchased the game BEFORE the launch on February 13, 2020 at 10:00 am PST are automatically eligible for the loyalty program.

This special deal allows those users to purchase the new character DLC for 50% off retail price! Qualifying users will see the discount automatically applied when they view the DLC.

*If you are logged in and prices do not reflect the discount, please reach out to Steam customer support.

The 50% off discount applies to the following new character DLC:
1. Azur Lane Crosswave - Taihou
2. Azur Lane Crosswave - Formidable
3. Azur Lane Crosswave - Roon
4. Azur Lane Crosswave - Le Malin
5. Azur Lane Crosswave - Sirius

* This discount is available from September 5th, 2020 to November 2nd.

notes.title: This latest update to the game adds the Simplified Chinese language option.
notes.content: This latest update to the game adds the Simplified Chinese language option.

notes.title: Minor issue fixes
notes.content:
Hello, we apologize for taking so long for fixes. Here are a few new fixes we have implemented to the game.

1. Fixed a bug where resolution mode 2560x1440 cannot be selected when your monitor resolution setting is set to 2560x1440.
2. Added V-sync option under graphics settings to reduce screen rip error.
3. Reduced excessive screen shake issue during combat.

Please let us know if you encounter any issues with this update. Thank you for your help.

notes.title: Fixes and some optimization
notes.content:
Hello, thank you for your patience. We have made some update fixes to Azur Lane Crosswave. Below are things that we repaired.

1. 4K resolution mode performance improvement: Reduced some lags and heavy loads.
2. In the key config mode the list of key entry now shows what action each button does for an easier understanding.
3. Several Chinese language text fixes.
4. Replaced Deluxe pack's mp3's to a higher bit rate version. It is now 320kbps.
5. In the key config screen we fixed a key assignment error.

If you encounter any issues with this latest update please let us know and we will work on it asap.

Again thank you for your patience and support.

notes.title: Update fix for Japanese language version（日本語版の不具合の修正につきまして）
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your patience. We have made fixes to an issue where your controlling character gets stuck in the 2nd battle for the Japanese version. There has also been updates to fix the blurriness to the 2D character art.
If you continue to encounter the issues though please let us know. We will do our best to fix them. Thank you for your help and support.

お客様には多大なご迷惑をおかけ致しましたことを深くお詫び申し上げます。
バトルシーンでプレイ不能になる問題及びに２Dのキャラ絵がぼやけて表示される問題につきまして修正を行いました。
もしその他不具合などございましたらカスタマーサポートまでご連絡をお願いいたします。

notes.content:

We’re also happy to announce Neptune from the beloved Neptunia™ series will be available as a free download on Steam for ONLY one month starting from the launch day. She will not be available for purchase or download after the month has passed.
